messages:
anya: promo blocked in CI. deploy-bot failing on cache prefetch with repeated 504s from cache-service. change window open, need quick decision.
kevin: same here. artifact exists in registry; only prefetch is timing out (attempts backoff).
deploy-bot: automated: promotion promo-90012 triggered by anya at 1717821111. state=PREFETCH_RETRY attempts=7/10 last_err=504.

sam-oncall: looking at cache-service: s3-proxy threads are stuck, queue length growing. scaling frontends didn't clear stuck conns. i'm going to recycle proxy nodes one at a time.

tess: options: 1) abort promo and wait for infra fix, 2) manual promote pinned digest and skip prefetch, 3) pin to last-good and re-run later. change window ends ~18m.

maria: prefer manual pin+skip-prefetch to avoid wasting window, but require immediate smoke + canary (2% for 30m) and a clear rollback entry.

kevin: deploy-bot supports `--skip-cache-prefetch`. tested on staging. I can run: `deploy-bot promote --env prod --image-sha sha256:112233aabb --skip-cache-prefetch --tag manual-skip-prefetch-031`. infra ok?

sam-oncall: i'll proceed with rolling restarts; but manual path sounds prudent.

anya: approved. kevin, please also update release notes and add short rollback instructions (target previous image sha256:bbccddee99).

kevin: executing manual promote now. job promo-90013 queued.

deploy-bot: update: promo-90013 started. note: prefetch skipped by flag. stage=artifact_activation -> in-progress.

deploy-bot: success: promo-90013 completed. prod image=sha256:112233aabb. tag=manual-skip-prefetch-031.

maria: starting smoke tests and canary routing. watching p95 and 5xx.

tess: adding release note: "Manual promotion due to transient cache prefetch 504s. Promoted sha256:112233aabb; prefetch skipped. Canary 2% for 30m. Rollback target sha256:bbccddee99." will push to release doc.

kevin: release notes + rollback playbook updated. support paged.

sam-oncall: after restarts, 504s dropped from ~22% -> ~1.8% over 3m. opening incident INC-2026-03-cache-19 for postmortem (suspect s3-proxy leak).

anya: thread pinned to release doc. follow-ups: add prefetch circuit-breaker in deploy-bot, document skip-prefetch flow, and postmortem action items. closing promo hold; will monitor 30m canary.

tess: change window record updated and incident linked. :white_check_mark:
